lesson.grammar_point: simple past of irregular verbs and did questions

listenings.text: Last weekend I finally had two free days in Rome, and I did not plan anything. On Saturday morning I got up late, I had a big breakfast, and I went for a walk with no map. I saw a small church, a market and a beautiful old square. I ate pizza in the street, like everybody. In the afternoon I took a bus to the wrong place, and it was the best mistake of the trip, because I found a little museum with no tourists in it. On Sunday I bought two souvenirs, one for my mother and one for me, and I went to the airport happy. Two days, no plan, and I did not miss anything.

Everybody asks me about my weekend in Cape Town, so here it is. I went there for the sun, and it rained for two days. On Saturday I went to the beach anyway, and I was the only person there. I sat in a small cafe and I had three coffees. I did not see the famous view from the mountain, because there were clouds everywhere. On Sunday I took a bus to the old town and I saw a music show in the street. That was the best part. I did not swim, and I did not take one good photo. But I met a family from Argentina, and we had dinner together. So, a bad weekend? No. A different weekend.

extra_audio.text: On Saturday I went on a tour of the old city. We had lunch by the river. In the afternoon I saw the view from the castle. I bought a souvenir for my son. And you? What did you do?
